en.Матрица - прямоугольная таблица чисел. Р: A matrix is a rectangular table of numbers. Size m×n means m rows and n columns. Before every operation, first check the sizes - this prevents most mistakes.

en.Каждая задача оформлена отдельно. Обозна: Each problem is worked out separately. Notation, rules and important restrictions are explained next to the calculation; matrices are typeset as mathematical formulas.
en.внутренние размеры должны совпасть; внеш: the inner sizes must match; the outer sizes give the result
en.Геометрический тест совместимости матриц: Geometric compatibility test for matrices before multiplication.
en.Квадратные: A(2×2), B(2×2), D,E,F,I₃ (3×: Square: A(2×2), B(2×2), D,E,F,I₃ (3×3), I₂ (2×2). Of order 3: D,E,F,I₃. Size 2×3: C. Four columns: H(1×4). Diagonal: I₂ and I₃ (a zero matrix would also be diagonal). Lower triangular: F, I₂, I₃. Symmetric: I₂, I₃. Identity: I₂, I₃. All the listed matrices are nonzero. Main diagonal - elements aᵢᵢ: A=(2,4), B=(2,-4), D=(1,-1,0), E=(2,0,0), F=(1,1,1).
en.Правило: складывать можно только одинако: Rule: only matrices of the same size can be added; the product of m×n by n×k has size m×k. Therefore C-3E and A-C² are undefined (mismatched sizes; C² is also undefined).
en.а) A+B= . б) 2A-B= . г) D-Fᵀ= . д) (A-B): a) A+B=\(\begin{bmatrix}4&0\\0&0\end{bmatrix}\). b) 2A-B=\(\begin{bmatrix}2&-9\\-3&12\end{bmatrix}\). d) D-Fᵀ=\(\begin{bmatrix}0&-1&-2\\0&-2&3\\2&-4&-1\end{bmatrix}\). e) (A-B)C=\(\begin{bmatrix}0&-18&-6\\-2&20&2\end{bmatrix}\). f) Cᵀ(A+B)=\(\begin{bmatrix}4&0\\8&0\\12&0\end{bmatrix}\). g) DEF=\(\begin{bmatrix}-1&2&-1\\-5&6&-2\\-2&4&-2\end{bmatrix}\). h) FI₃=F. i) B³=\(\begin{bmatrix}8&45\\15&-82\end{bmatrix}\). j) E⁴=\(\begin{bmatrix}35&56&57\\25&39&41\\27&21&48\end{bmatrix}\). k) GH=\(\begin{bmatrix}4&8&12&16\\3&6&9&12\\2&4&6&8\\1&2&3&4\end{bmatrix}\).
a) D+E=E+D by componentwise addition. b) (AB)ᵀ=BᵀAᵀ=\(\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\18&-19\end{bmatrix}\). c) GH is a 4×4 matrix, while HG=\(\begin{bmatrix}20\end{bmatrix}\) has size 1×1, so they are not equal. d) (A-B)²=\(\begin{bmatrix}12&-48\\-16&76\end{bmatrix}\), whereas A²-2AB+B²=\(\begin{bmatrix}12&-60\\-12&76\end{bmatrix}\). Reason: (A-B)²=A²-AB-BA+B²; replacing -AB-BA by -2AB is allowed only if AB=BA. Exceptional cases: commuting matrices; for GH=HG - compatible square matrices that commute.
en.A 4×2, B 3×2, C 2×4. а) A+B не определен: A 4×2, B 3×2, C 2×4. a) A+B undefined. b) C-2Aᵀ: both 2×4, result 2×4. c) CA: (2×4)(4×2)=2×2; then ·Bᵀ (2×3) ⇒ 2×3. d) AB undefined (2≠3). e) BAᵀ: (3×2)(2×4)=3×4; multiplying by Cᵀ (4×2) ⇒3×2. f) C+Aᵀ has size 2×4; B(3×2)·(...) ⇒3×4.
en.а) После умножения [x,2,1]·M получаем [x: a) Multiplying [x,2,1]·M gives [x,2x+2,3x+5]. The dot product with [x,2,0]ᵀ equals x²+2(2x+2)=(x+2)². Hence x=-2. b) The right-hand transposed matrix is \(\begin{bmatrix}3&y\\6&z\end{bmatrix}\). Comparing entries: 2(x+2)=3 ⇒ x=-1/2; 2(y+3)=y ⇒ y=-6; 2·3=6 holds; 0=z ⇒ z=0.
en.а) ²= =0. б) Обе матрицы 3×3. Строка 1 ×: a) \(\begin{bmatrix}-6&-9\\4&6\end{bmatrix}\)²=\(\begin{bmatrix}36-36&54-54\\-24+24&-36+36\end{bmatrix}\)=0. b) Both matrices are 3×3. Row 1 × columns: [1+1−1, 1−3+2, −1+2−1]=[1,0,0]; row 2: [1+2−3, 1−6+6, −1+4−3]=[0,1,0]; row 3: [1+3−4, 1−9+8, −1+6−4]=[0,0,1]. We get I₃, so the second matrix is the inverse of the first.
en.а) Решая по столбцам систему X= , получа: a) Solving column by column the system \(\begin{bmatrix}2&1\\3&2\end{bmatrix}\)X=\(\begin{bmatrix}1&2\\3&4\end{bmatrix}\), we get X=\(\begin{bmatrix}-1&0\\3&2\end{bmatrix}\). b) Add the first equation and a suitable combination: from X-Y=P and -X+4Y=Q it follows that 3Y=P+Q, Y=(P+Q)/3, X=P+Y. For P=\(\begin{bmatrix}0&2\\3&-1\end{bmatrix}\), Q=\(\begin{bmatrix}3&2\\0&4\end{bmatrix}\): Y=\(\begin{bmatrix}1&4/3\\1&1\end{bmatrix}\), X=\(\begin{bmatrix}1&10/3\\4&0\end{bmatrix}\).
en.в) XP=Q даёт X= . г) Размеры не согласов: c) XP=Q gives X=\(\begin{bmatrix}-4&3\\-6&5\end{bmatrix}\). d) The sizes are inconsistent. Let N=[[0,0,2],[0,4,0]] (2×3). The right-hand side ½(X−N) is defined only if X has size 2×3. But then on the left the product X·[[1,0,0],[0,2,0]], i.e. (2×3)·(2×3), is undefined (3≠2). If instead X has 2 columns (so that the left side exists), then X−N is undefined. No solutions. e) Adding: 2X=I+J, where J is the matrix with ones on the anti-diagonal, so X=(I+J)/2=[[½,0,½],[0,1,0],[½,0,½]]; subtracting: 2Y=I−J, Y=[[½,0,−½],[0,0,0],[−½,0,½]].
en.а) A= ⇒ Aⁿ= . б) Матрица меняет местами: a) A=\(\begin{bmatrix}1&1\\0&1\end{bmatrix}\) ⇒ Aⁿ=\(\begin{bmatrix}1&n\\0&1\end{bmatrix}\). b) The matrix swaps the 1st and 3rd coordinates: A²=I, so Aⁿ=A for odd n and I for even n. c) A²=I, same parity. d) A has the block \(\begin{bmatrix}1&1\\1&1\end{bmatrix}\) on coordinates 1 and 3; Aⁿ=\(\begin{bmatrix}2^(n-1)&0&2^(n-1)\\0&1&0\\2^(n-1)&0&2^(n-1)\end{bmatrix}\) for n≥1.
en.а) Умножаем A·[5,10,8]ᵀ. Получаем [66,41: a) Multiply A·[5,10,8]ᵀ. We get [66,41,46,60]ᵀ units of 0.1 mg for B₁,B₂,B₆,C respectively. b) Multiply the price vector [0.15; 0.25; 0.30; 0.50] on the left by A. The cost of the vitamin content of one unit of the foods: [1.85; 2.35; 3.90] zł.
en.Сначала A²= . Затем f(A)=2A²-5A+5I₃= . П: First A²=\(\begin{bmatrix}7&4&7\\4&9&6\\3&5&4\end{bmatrix}\). Then f(A)=2A²-5A+5I₃=\(\begin{bmatrix}19&-7&9\\-2&18&2\\1&5&8\end{bmatrix}\). The order of operations is the same as for a numeric polynomial, but the constant term 5 means 5I₃.
en.Пусть X= . Из AX=XA получаем y=3z и w=x+: Let X=\(\begin{bmatrix}x&y\\z&w\end{bmatrix}\). From AX=XA we get y=3z and w=x+3z; the other equations coincide. Therefore all solutions are: X=\(\begin{bmatrix}α&3β\\β&α+3β\end{bmatrix}\), where α,β∈ℝ.
en.Ищем L= с положительной диагональю. Посл: We look for L=\(\begin{bmatrix}l11&0&0\\l21&l22&0\\l31&l32&l33\end{bmatrix}\) with a positive diagonal. Step by step: l11=√1=1; l21=-2; l31=1; l22=√(5-4)=1; l32=(-3-l31·l21)/l22=-1; l33=√(6-l31²-l32²)=2. Answer L=\(\begin{bmatrix}1&0&0\\-2&1&0\\1&-1&2\end{bmatrix}\). Directly multiplying LLᵀ returns the original matrix.
en.Пример для Варшавы, Берлина, Праги и Вен: Example for Warsaw, Berlin, Prague and Vienna (rounded road distances, km): D=\(\begin{bmatrix}0&575&680&680\\575&0&350&680\\680&350&0&335\\680&680&335&0\end{bmatrix}\). The diagonal is zero, and Dᵀ=D, because the distance i→j is taken to equal j→i. In coursework, other cities and verified distances are acceptable.
en.Сумма требует одинакового размера. Для A: A sum requires the same size. For AB the number of columns of A equals the number of rows of B; the result has the outer dimensions.
en.(A+B)ᵀ=Aᵀ+Bᵀ; (AB)ᵀ=BᵀAᵀ - порядок множи: (A+B)ᵀ=Aᵀ+Bᵀ; (AB)ᵀ=BᵀAᵀ - the order of the factors is reversed.
en.A⁰=I; Aⁿ=A·A·…·A. Раскрытие (A-B)² даёт: A⁰=I; Aⁿ=A·A·…·A. Expanding (A-B)² gives A²-AB-BA+B²; the formula with -2AB holds only when AB=BA.
en.Для симметричной положительно определённ: For a symmetric positive definite matrix S there is a unique lower triangular L with a positive diagonal such that S=LLᵀ.
